items.name: fx
items.title: fx
items.description: runFx(): plays a one-shot motion utility (yorha-glitch, yorha-flicker) by toggling data-run, with a 1000 ms per-element floor (WCAG 2.3.1: at most three flashes per second).
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Import with: import { runFx } from "@/lib/fx". Under data-motion=off the attribute is removed at once.
